verdict.rationale: Supabase's MCP server and RLS policies theoretically allow scoped, per-user access for AI agents, and Supabase engineers describe added prompt-injection mitigations encouraging read-only agent access. However, hands-on community reports show the Cursor/MCP integration commonly uses the service_role key, which bypasses RLS entirely, undermining least-privilege guarantees and raising trust concerns about elevated access for agents.
